message:
release: 0.2.123 -- the picker goes through the swapchain

Carries the hypothesis 5 fix: the picker is presented through the same swapchain the
video uses instead of being drawn into a window that a flip-model present has made
unreachable for GDI.

Five artifacts changed: Client, Host, Setup, Updater, Viewer. ui/shell.html is byte for
byte what 0.2.121 and 0.2.122 published, so the hash pin in client_update_ui_test still
resolves against the signed manifest.

Gates before publishing: the manifest names all ten payload files, the product verifier
accepts the real document and refuses it with one byte changed, and the installer's
nine embedded resources hash to what the manifest says. After publishing: ten artifacts
fetched anonymously over https hash as signed, the server's own pair was read back and
re-verified through the product verifier, the 0.2.122 pair is backed up, two 0.2.122
artifacts were re-fetched and are unchanged, and the installer in dist compares equal to
what the public URL serves.

Still unproven: that a real session shows the picker, which is the only thing that
settles whether the user's symptom had this cause.
